newsitem.title: USA: Kennametal sees Q4 boost from U.S. economy.
newsitem.headline: Kennametal sees Q4 boost from U.S. economy.

text.p: Kennametal Inc on Wednesday said it sees fourth-quarter sales in the North American metalworking market benefitting from slowly improving economic conditions in the United States.
For the third quarter ended March 31, sales in the North American metalworking market fell two percent from last year.
The company said sales in the Europe metalworking market are expected to remain weak. Sales in the Asia-Pacific metalworking market are expected to continue to be slow.

Third-quarter sales in the Europe metalworking market fell 11 percent. Demand there for metalworking products continues to be slow due to weak economic conditions in Europe, principally in Germany, the firm said. Sales grew at a faster pace in the United Kingdom and in France.

In the Asia-Pacific metalworking market, third quarter sales rose six percent as a result of increased demand in Australia, Singapore and Japan, although sales were again hurt by soft economic conditions in Korea and Thailand. Earlier,
the companys said net income for its third quarter ended March 31, 1997 was $19.9 million, or $0.75 per share, down 15 percent from $23.4 million, or $0.88 per share in the same quarter last year.
